title: Dispatch: 19.4.6 census governing cost citations (review 19.4.6.11 S1) (attempt 7)
description:
Repair review eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.11 S1 (read its notes in FULL: the ~50-row list, closure and "No requirement" sections). Branch eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.12 cut from eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 at 44b9caec. Model: Codex gpt-6-luna.

PROBLEM: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemActivationCensus.json (362 rows) has costSentence values that are verbatim sentences of the same item but NOT the sentence that governs that operation's cost (e.g. Luck Blade cast-wish quotes the Luck '(no action required)' sentence; Rod of Lordly Might terrify quotes the six-buttons 'bonus action' sentence; Crystal Ball of Telepathy cast-suggestion quotes the Mind Reading variant; Ioun Greater Absorption quotes the Absorption variant's 4th-level sentence; dismissal/return/close rows quote the initiation sentence; charge-free casts quote a different charged-spell list). Typed cost VALUES are correct — only the evidence binding is wrong. Do NOT change any emitted pack value, cost, equipment, ready set (must stay exactly the same 19 ready identities), adjudicated spans or captain untyped-continuation dispositions (Ring of the Ram attack sentence, Dragon Scale Mail, Dwarven Plate, Candle of Invocation stay untyped).

WORK:
1. Re-derive EVERY row with non-null cost (264 rows: action/bonus-action/reaction/free/consume), not only the listed ones. For each, quote the operation's OWN governing printed sentence (or a genuinely governing header/continuation that names this act). For a variant scope (Scope::Variant) quote that variant's sentence. For an operation spanning multiple printed branches, the evidence must cover those branches (costSentence may become an array ONLY if the test/schema is updated accordingly; prefer a single sentence when one governs). If no printed sentence for this operation states or governs the cost, STOP on that row: do not invent — report it in your completion notes as a candidate where the typed cost lacks authority (captain decides). Include the 'consume' rows: e.g. Marvelous Pigments currently cites 'Typically found in 1d4 pots...' and Spell Scroll cites the cipher sentence — cite the sentence describing the consuming act.
2. Cheap contradiction check in magicItemTriage.test.ts (alongside existing parity): for cost action/bonus-action/reaction/free, costSentence must contain the cost's printed token ('action' outside 'bonus action'; 'bonus action'; 'reaction'; 'no action required' or equivalent printed wording) and must not contain a contradicting token, with an explicit small allowlist (each entry justified in a comment) for sentences that legitimately print two costs. Consume rows: no token rule required.
3. Permanent source-fidelity assertions (proportionate, not per-row): Luck Blade cast-wish binds the wish sentence (wrong-action-type case), Rod of Lordly Might terrify binds 'force each creature ... Wisdom saving throw' sentence, a same-cost/different-operation case (e.g. Eversmoking Bottle close or Instant Fortress dismiss binds its own sentence not the opening one), and a variant-binding case (Ioun Greater Absorption binds its 8th-level sentence; Crystal Ball of Telepathy cast-suggestion binds its own suggestion sentence).
4. Completion notes: list every row whose costSentence changed (scope/operation: old -> new, short), every row left unchanged by judgement, and any no-authority candidates from step 1.

Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Keep inventory --check and pack verification passing.
